title: Dave Made a Maze
review: It's like {Backrooms} meets {It Takes Two}. Dave himself the weakest performance, but nobody was stand-out great. I didn't mind because the haphazard construction of the maze was mirrored by the haphazard craft of the film. There's no way you can convincingly sell this through a naturalistic performance, so they keep it light and fun. Not every idea it threw at me landed, but enough did that I ended up happy to have seen it. Similarly to {Rubber}, another movie I saw recently, it is dragged down a bit by a self-referential meta-narrative. It's at its most exciting when new things are happening in the maze, and its least exciting when it slows down to talk about itself. I can't say I particularly liked the ending, or the animated title sequence either. It wasn't much of a horror but there was some comedy dismemberment, which was really imaginative.
